1: // Minimal Orbit Defender game
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: (function(){
4:   // Audio setup using Web Audio API
5:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
6:   function playTone(freq, duration, type='sine') {
7:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
8:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
9:     osc.type = type;
10:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
11:     osc.connect(gain);
12:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
13:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
14:     osc.start();
15:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
16:   }
17:   const sounds = {
18:     shoot: () => playTone(600, 0.05),
19:     explosion: () => playTone(200, 0.2, 'triangle'),
20:     hit: () => playTone(100, 0.3, 'sawtooth'),
21:     gameOver: () => { for(let i=0;i<3;i++) playTone(150,0.2,i*0.2); }
22:   };
23:   // Continue original code
24:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
25:   if (!canvas) return;
26:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
27:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
28:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
29:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
30:   if (!canvas) return;
31:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
32:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
33:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
34: 
35:   // Game objects
36:   const planet = {x: width/2, y: height/2, radius: 40, health: 10};
37:   const ship = {angle: 0, radius: 80, size: 10, cooldown: 0};
38:   const asteroids = [];
39:   const bullets = [];
40:   const stars = [];
41:   let score = 0;
42:   let lastTime = 0;
43:   // create background stars
44:   (function initStars() {
45:     const count = 100;
46:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
47:       stars.push({
48:         x: Math.random() * width,
49:         y: Math.random() * height,
50:         size: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
51:       });
52:     }
53:   })();
54: 
55:   // Helper functions
56:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
57:   const dist = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
58: 
59:   function spawnAsteroid() {
60:     const angle = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
61:     const r = Math.max(width, height);
62:     const x = planet.x + Math.cos(angle) * r;
63:     const y = planet.y + Math.sin(angle) * r;
64:     const speed = rand(0.5, 1.5);
65:     asteroids.push({x, y, angle, speed, radius: 12});
66:   }
67: 
68:   function update(dt) {
69:     // ship rotation (left/right arrow)
70:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= dt * 0.002;
71:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += dt * 0.002;
72:     // fire (space)
73:     if (keys[' '] && ship.cooldown <= 0) {
74:       const bx = planet.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.radius;
75:       const by = planet.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.radius;
76:       bullets.push({x: bx, y: by, angle: ship.angle, speed: 4});
77:       ship.cooldown = 200; // ms
78:       sounds.shoot();
79:     }
80:     ship.cooldown -= dt;
81: 
82:     // move bullets
83:     bullets.forEach(b => {
84:       b.x += Math.cos(b.angle) * b.speed * dt;
85:       b.y += Math.sin(b.angle) * b.speed * dt;
86:     });
87:     // remove off‑screen bullets
88:     for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
89:       const b = bullets[i];
90:       if (b.x < 0 || b.x > width || b.y < 0 || b.y > height) bullets.splice(i, 1);
91:     }
92: 
93:     // move asteroids toward planet
94:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
95:       const dx = planet.x - a.x;
96:       const dy = planet.y - a.y;
97:       const ang = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
98:       a.x += Math.cos(ang) * a.speed * dt;
99:       a.y += Math.sin(ang) * a.speed * dt;
100:     });
101: 
102:     // collision bullet‑asteroid
103:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
104:       const a = asteroids[i];
105:       for (let j = bullets.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
106:         const b = bullets[j];
107:         if (dist(a, b) < a.radius) {
108:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
109:           bullets.splice(j, 1);
110:           score++;
111:           sounds.explosion();
112:           break;
113:         }
114:       }
115:     }
116: 
117:     // asteroid‑planet
118:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
119:       const a = asteroids[i];
120: if (dist(a, planet) < a.radius + planet.radius) {
121:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
122:           planet.health--;
123:           sounds.hit();
124:           if (planet.health <= 0) {
125:             // game over – stop loop
126:             cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
127:             sounds.gameOver();
128:             alert('Game Over! Score: ' + score);
129:           }
130:         }
131:     }
132:   }
133: 
134:   function draw() {
135:     // Background
136:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
137:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
138:     // Stars
139:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
140:     stars.forEach(s => {
141:       ctx.beginPath();
142:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
143:       ctx.fill();
144:     });
145:     // Planet with radial gradient
146:     const planetGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
147:       planet.x - planet.radius / 3,
148:       planet.y - planet.radius / 3,
149:       planet.radius / 8,
150:       planet.x,
151:       planet.y,
152:       planet.radius
153:     );
154:     planetGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4caf50');
155:     planetGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1b5e20');
156:     ctx.fillStyle = planetGrad;
157:     ctx.beginPath();
158:     ctx.arc(planet.x, planet.y, planet.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
159:     ctx.fill();
160:     // Ship – white triangle with outline
161:     const sx = planet.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.radius;
162:     const sy = planet.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.radius;
163:     const tipX = sx + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.size * 1.5;
164:     const tipY = sy + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.size * 1.5;
165:     const leftX = sx + Math.cos(ship.angle + Math.PI * 0.75) * ship.size;
166:     const leftY = sy + Math.sin(ship.angle + Math.PI * 0.75) * ship.size;
167:     const rightX = sx + Math.cos(ship.angle - Math.PI * 0.75) * ship.size;
168:     const rightY = sy + Math.sin(ship.angle - Math.PI * 0.75) * ship.size;
169:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
170:     ctx.beginPath();
171:     ctx.moveTo(tipX, tipY);
172:     ctx.lineTo(leftX, leftY);
173:     ctx.lineTo(rightX, rightY);
174:     ctx.closePath();
175:     ctx.fill();
176:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#888';
177:     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
178:     ctx.stroke();
179:     // Bullets with glow
180:     ctx.shadowColor = '#ff0';
181:     ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
182:     bullets.forEach(b => {
183:       ctx.beginPath();
184:       ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
185:       ctx.fill();
186:     });
187:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0; // reset
188:     // Asteroids with rocky gradient
189:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
190:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
191:         a.x - a.radius / 3,
192:         a.y - a.radius / 3,
193:         a.radius / 5,
194:         a.x,
195:         a.y,
196:         a.radius
197:       );
198:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#b8860b');
199:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#5d4037');
200:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
201:       ctx.beginPath();
202:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
203:       ctx.fill();
204:     });
205:     // HUD
206:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
207:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
208:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
209:     ctx.fillText('Health: ' + planet.health, 10, 40);
210:   }
211: 
212:   const keys = {};
213:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
214:     keys[e.key] = true;
215:     // Resume audio context on first interaction
216:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
217:   });
218:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);
219: 
220:   let animId;
221:   function loop(timestamp) {
222:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
223:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
224:     lastTime = timestamp;
225:     // spawn asteroids over time
226:     if (Math.random() < dt * 0.001) spawnAsteroid();
227:     update(dt);
228:     draw();
229:     animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
230:   }
231:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
232: })();
